invariant: ADR-0155 D1, D4: a fixed-read leaf compiles only as the `$in` comparand of a field's operator map; every other position is refused with INTERNAL_ERROR / 500, never read as an ordinary comparand. The inner read's predicates come from the leaf's own description (`fixedInnerReadOf`), so no compiler restates them, and its tenant scope is the literal `'none'` (① ruled A): a widened type stops this module compiling until every compiler answers it.
